svg.title: faz.ai — Manifesto Storyboard
svg.desc: 10-slide narrative map. Internal/founder-aligned audience, ~20 min. Defends faz.ai's values commitments at every quarterly review for ten years. Ask: adopt the values, refuse to ship the alternatives.
